cohort: 201 pregnant women who tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 and delivered at a dedicated COVID hospital between May 2020 and October 2020
finding: The rate of vertical transmission of SARS-CoV-2 was 0.99% in this study.
mod_finding: One baby born vaginally and one baby born by caesarian section tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 by RT-PCR.
gest_age: >40 weeks in both babies who tested positive for SARS-CoV-2
